prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production equipment item icons (jewelry accessories) for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG. Image1 is the existing accessory sheet of this game: match its finely detailed pixel-illustrated painterly style, dark outlines, lighting and scale exactly; never copy its items. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly FIVE separate items in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, row 1 cells 1-3, row 2 cells 4-5, and the sixth cell (bottom-right) left completely EMPTY. Necklace chains stay short and compact inside the cell. Each item is a single object (an earring is ONE single earring, not a pair). Each item clearly readable at small icon size and clearly distinct from the others. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.
